heroSub: FiveStar AI na-echepụta ma wuo ụdị sọftụwia ọ bụla — mkpanaka, webụ, desktọpụ, azụ azụ, na AI — na-eji LLM arụ ọrụ n'ofe asụsụ mmemme yana nchịkọta teknụzụ.
m1Sub: AI n'oge imewe, nzuzo na QA
m2Sub: Asụsụ ọ bụla, ikpo okwu ma ọ bụ ụkpụrụ
m3Sub: Site na prototype ruo na mmepụta
m4Sub: Mwepụta, rụọ ọrụ ma na-aga n'ihu na-emeziwanye
aboutLead: Anyị bụ ụlọ ọrụ ngwanrọ AI nwere ahụmịhe miri emi na mmepe na-akwado LLM. Anyị na-atụgharị nsogbu azụmahịa ka ọ bụrụ ngwaahịa a pụrụ ịdabere na ya na-enweghị njedebe site na otu asụsụ mmemme, ikpo okwu, ma ọ bụ nchịkọta teknụzụ.
missionBody: Anyị na-eji AI na LLM ịhọrọ ngwaọrụ kwesịrị ekwesị maka nsogbu ọ bụla wee nyefee n'ofe nchịkọta teknụzụ.
principlesBody: AI na-eme ka ọrụ ahụ dịkwuo elu; ndị injinia anyị na-anọgide na-aza ajụjụ maka ụkpụrụ ụlọ, ịdịmma, nchekwa na nsonaazụ.
focusBody: Mobile, webụ, desktọpụ, backend, AI agents, data sistemu, na workflow automation.
productsLead: Ngwaahịa anyị na-egosi otu anyị si ewere echiche iji malite gafee AI, mkpanaka, dọkụmentị, mgbasa ozi, na ngwanrọ nrụpụta.
p1: Usoro ọrụ OCR maka akwụkwọ a gbara scan: wepụta, chọta, chụọ mkpụrụ okwu, TTS—nchekwa nzuzo site n'inhazi n'ebe a.
p2: Ngwa ngwa mgbasa ozi mpaghara dị mfe na-enweghị mgbasa ozi yana ahụmịhe dị nro n'ofe nyiwe mkpanaka.
p4: Sọftweer na-ejikọ na AI dị n'ebe a iji mepụta nhazi nkasa na mkparịta ụka nzuzo.
p5: Mee ka screenshot ndị App Store dị mfe itụgharị na ịhazi ha n'asụsụ dị iche iche maka nyere ha.
p6: Chat nso dabere na nkwekọ site na Bluetooth, nwere nhọrọ nghgharị AI lokal. Enweghị akaunt, enweghị server chat nke etiti.
p7: Onye na-achịkwa pas maara ebe onye nọ. Ọ na-ewepụta coupon ma ọ bụ kaadị onye otu kwesịrị ekwesị n'oge ị rute.
p3: Site na sistemu ime na ọrụ webụ gaa na ekwentị, desktọpụ na ngwaahịa AI. Anyị na-ahọrọ asụsụ kacha mma na nchịkọta maka nsogbu ọ bụla.
b2: Ekwentị mkpanaaka, webụ na ngwaahịa desktọpụ
qualityTitle: Otu anyị si achọpụta ịdị mma
q3: Arụmọrụ, ntụkwasị obi na nleba anya
servicesLead: LLM-accelerated engineering na-atụgharị nsogbu akọwapụtara nke ọma ka ọ bụrụ ngwanrọ na-arụ ọrụ ngwa ngwa.
s1Body: Kọwaa ebumnuche azụmahịa, ndị ọrụ, ihe mgbochi na ụzọ teknụzụ ziri ezi.
s2Body: Jiri injinia na-enyere LLM aka chepụta, mejuputa, nwalee, na imeghari n'ofe nyiwe.
s3Body: Bufee, nyochaa, rụọ ọrụ, ma na-aga n'ihu na-emezi ngwaahịa ahụ.
contactLead: Gwa anyị ihe ị chọrọ ịrụ. Anyị ga-atụ aro ụzọ bara uru site na echiche ruo mmalite.
